description: This file contains Redux reducer functions for managing thread counts and related state in the Mattermost application, including handling actions for reading threads, leaving teams/channels, and updating unread counts.

methods.name: isDmGmChannel
methods.description: Checks if the channel type is a direct message or group message channel.

methods.name: handleAllTeamThreadsRead
methods.description: Resets unread thread counts for a team when all threads are marked as read.

methods.name: isEqual
methods.description: Compares thread count states to determine if they are equal based on unread mentions, threads, and total count.

methods.name: handleReadChangedThread
methods.description: Updates unread counts when a thread's read status changes.

methods.name: handleLeaveTeam
methods.description: Removes a team's thread counts from the state when leaving a team.

methods.name: handleLeaveChannel
methods.description: Updates thread counts when a channel is deleted or left, based on threads to delete.

methods.name: handleDecrementThreadCounts
methods.description: Decrements thread counts for a team when a thread is closed or unread count decreases.

methods.name: countsIncludingDirectReducer
methods.description: Reducer handling thread counts, including direct message and group message channels.

methods.name: countsReducer
methods.description: Reducer handling thread counts for general cases, excluding direct message channels.
